title: indy_sign and indy_verify_signature should support arbitrary byte array
description: Right now, {indy_sign}} and {{indy_verify_signature}} can create/verify signatures for the JSON messages that are sent to the ledger. In these methods, a JSON message is serialized to a byte array using a custom algorithm that is not used outside of Indy/Sovrin ledger communication. Also, the signature is automatically inserted into the JSON message.    I think it would be very useful if those methods could be used more generically, to create/verify signatures on any arbitrary byte array supplied by the library user.    [ Creating this JIRA issue and closing the Github issue: [https://github.com/hyperledger/indy-sdk/issues/32] ]
